reviews.text: First time here and I’m very impressed with their kindness and patience with my girls. Nail trim has always been a problem but they managed to do it and I heard no yelping. Thank you

I’ve been taking my cats, Shah Tak and Pashmak (Diana), to Culebra Creek Vet for a year now, and we always have wonderful experiences. The team is kindly professional, super loving, and patient with them, and I always feel at peace knowing they’re in good hands. 🐾✨
Both of my cats have been in great health, and I can truly see the care and kindness they receive at every visit. 💕 Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a trustworthy and warm veterinary clinic.

This vet is amazing! My pup sully is super skittish, but they make him feel at ease. Every member of the staff is the kindest sweetest soul ever and the grooming is THE BEST groomer I’ve ever encountered. Dez is fantastic. It’s also helpful that it’s attached to the vet so makes you feel like they’re putting extra care into your pup’s treatment and grooming. Highly recommend! 🌟

Culebra Creek Vet is awesome! We bring our 10 year old Pit terrier mix here for his annual check ups and any other medical needs. The staff is very thorough and friendly. They never try to upsell you on additional procedures/tests unless they are absolutely necessary. Additionally, they are transparent about the costs of services provided. If you live in this area, I would definitely recommend bringing your pet here.

I took my schnauzer today to get checked out. I had been worried about some changes to his health. They were able to get me in as a drop off. I had called 4 other places and they were booked or extremely expensive. Everyone in this clinic was kind, patient, knowledgeable, and had great customer service. Thank you all so much and thank you to the doctor who answered all the questions I had. Jax is thankful as well.
We have been going to Culebra Creek for years.  Dr Gass is very knowledgeable and compassionate as well as all the staff.  We are confident in the care they have provided all our dogs.

Jodi, is an exceptional tech. From the clear communication and expert diagnosis to the genuine compassion shown to both our pet and our family, the experience was top-tier. I was so grateful to have found a tech we trust completely and would recommend them to anyone seeking the very best care for their furry family member.

Your combination of expert medical knowledge and genuine compassion provided immense comfort during a very stressful time. You not only cared for our pet, but you also cared for my understanding of the situation.

I was so impressed with how thoroughly you explained the diagnosis and treatment options. You treated us as partners in our pet's care, and that meant the world to me.

Thank you for the incredible patience and gentleness you showed Adonis and Atticus. It's clear you don't just see an animal; you see a beloved family member.

Your calm and confident demeanor immediately put me and them at ease. I knew we were in the best possible hands. I definitely recommend this veterinarian and Jodi!!!

I'll start by saying the vets and staff here are fantastic. My experience inside the exam room was never the issue. What drove me away was a corporate policy change that showed me where this clinic's real priorities are.

Sometime in mid-April, Destination Pet, the company that owns this clinic, stopped approving prescription requests from third party pharmacies like Chewy. They now push everyone onto their own platform called VetCove. I found out when my order got declined after my cats had literally just been seen here with a valid prescription.

This is a bigger deal than it sounds. Third party pharmacies like Chewy exist because pet medication is expensive. They offer competitive prices, promotions, and honestly some of the best customer service out there. When a vet clinic cuts off access to those options, they are not protecting your pet. They are protecting their own revenue. For families on a tight budget, losing access to a cheaper pharmacy could mean their pet goes without the medication they need.

The clinic informed me I could still request a written prescription and fill it wherever you want. That sounds reasonable until you realize that all Chewy needed was a simple approval that takes minutes. Instead you are now expected to separately request a written prescription then submit it yourself. That is entirely unnecessary friction that the clinic created. It should have been as simple as approving the order and having the medication shipped out without a second thought.

When I brought up the price difference, the practice manager tried to tell me the two platforms were comparable. I sent back my actual order confirmation proving I would have paid $42 more through VetCove. I never got a reply. The clinic offered apologies but no actual accountability and made zero effort to keep me as a client. No gesture, no attempt to make things right, just empty words and a policy they refused to budge on. It took me escalating above the clinic entirely before anyone actually engaged with my concerns in a meaningful way.

I escalated to the District Manager, Brittani Mendez, who was responsive and accountable in a way I honestly did not expect at that point in time. She told me third party approvals should never have been blocked in the first place and that the staff are being retrained. I appreciated that and it is the only reason this is not a one star review. That said, I am skeptical about whether this is a genuine policy correction or simply damage control after I pushed hard enough. I won't be sticking around to find out. The trust I had with this clinic has already been broken.

If you are a current client who uses Chewy, it is worth asking whether third party approvals are back. You deserve to know. The medical staff here is wonderful but a clinic is only as strong as its weakest link, and unfortunately that weak link is the corporation pulling the strings.

Update: I am changing this back to 1 star. After posting this review I noticed that the clinic has responded to every single review on their page except mine, including reviews that were posted after mine. For a clinic that responds to every five star review within a day, the silence on this one says everything. They had every opportunity to at least publicly acknowledge my concerns and chose not to. Draw your own conclusions.

I recently took my fluffy cat, Rugrat, to Culebra Creek Vet Hospital because she had become severely matted. This was my second visit for this issue, and once again, I was incredibly impressed with the care and professionalism of the staff. They were able to safely sedate her and, although it was necessary to shave her, I am beyond grateful for their help.

I can only imagine how much better Rugrat feels now that she’s free of those tangles. She’s so soft and comfortable, and it’s a relief to see her happy again. Thank you, Culebra Creek Vet Hospital, for your excellent service and for taking such good care of my beloved cat. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of veterinary care!

I have included some pictures from the first and second visit:)

We boarded our Maltese for 4 nights over the New Year weekend this past weekend. Today we picked him up. These pics are not able to pick up the smell that went with the look that he had when the staffer brought him out. Our little Maltese was shaking like a leaf and looked like he has been standing for some time in urine and feces.
When I asked the staffer what happened, his response was "he may have peed and pooped in his crate", stating that they tried to clean him up a bit... Absolutely abusive and cruel. He did not deserve this and they should not be in business allowing this kind of treatment of animals to go on in their facility.

They do not deserve any stars for this treatment. If I could do this without giving one, it would be closer to the truth than the one star that Google makes you select to post the review. .. Beware of using their facility.. The staffer at the counter offered no refund,  told me that they do not know what happened,  but will have their Office Manager Jennifer to call me back in the am...
I love Culebra Creek! I have taken all my animals here and I feel they always take such great care of them. They are supportive and very informative when it comes to my animal's health.

My chi-mix had an accident and had a small cut on her face. The team and vet at culebra creek was able to take her on short notice and took such good care of her. I was so happy with how my dog was treated. You can tell they really care about the animals they treat and the pricing was fair.
I will be bring all my animals here.

I love this place
The doctor is amazing and all the vet tech are sweet and caring. CASSIE is the best! My normally scared puppers went right to her no problem.

Sometimes thank you is just not enough. While the “How it happened” is still somewhat of a mystery; the amazing treatment and kind, caring staff at Culebra Creek is certainly not. Our dog Piper fractured her tail and although she wobbles a bit while walking and is at odds with her new attached pink/purple friend, she is going to be just fine.

My sincerest thanks go out to Opeartions Manager Jennifer and Dr.Cuica for their kindness, professionalism and even jokes during Pipers ordeal. These guys and the Culebra Creek staff as a whole are amazing! On behalf of myself and Piper, Thank you!
So good with my dogs and genuinely care about their well being. Staff is very knowledgeable and very helpful.

I find it very exciting that they offer Veterinary, Grooming, Boarding, and Daycare services for both cats and dogs at really good pricing!
I really appreciate how they require all pets to be vaccinated against all vaccinations because I know I do not have to worry about my fur babies getting sick. During my vet visits they even showed me treatment plan before so I can approve all charges and procedures!
Truly a great clinic, Dr. and Staff Treat me like family!
Thanks Culebra Creek ! :)
I have two dogs i bring here. This vet does a great job and makes sure my animals vaccines are up to date. Well done culebra creek veterinary hospital.

I take all of my cats to Culebra Creek for annual check ups and reoccurring visits for one of my cats conditions. The staff has always been incredibly helpful and attentive, they always make me feel so welcome and happy to be there despite my situations. Everytime I visit, I see how much they care not only for my cats, but for others who visit as well. Dr. Gass is an amazing veterinarian who takes the time to answer all my questions I have and provides clear information to any situations that arise.

Culebra Creek Vet Hospital & Resort was impressive to say the least. Clean waiting room and lobby. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable and communicative. Just moved to SA from AZ and I'm sooo happy that we selected Culebra Creek as our Vet Clinic. My dog loved  the vet tech, Jodie, and Alexa and Suri at the front desk are exemplary of what quality customer care should be. When I initially called in, Alexa, made me feel heard and cared about, she went the extra mile to accommodate us.  I also trust my dog's judgement and he interacted with the staff willingly, which he doesn't do easily.  We highly recommend Culebra Creek.
